findings.evidence: AssociatedGraded.lean:521-527 is the only occurrence of `DirectSum.of` in the file; `gradedGOne_one` (:336) and `gradedGMul_mul` (:345) bridge the `GOne`/`GMul` fields but nothing bridges `DirectSum.GAlgebra.toFun`. Mathlib's `DirectSum.of_zero_one` (mathlib/Mathlib/Algebra/DirectSum/Ring.lean:378) is keyed on `(1 : A 0)` and `DirectSum.algebraMap_apply` (mathlib/Mathlib/Algebra/DirectSum/Algebra.lean:101) on `GAlgebra.toFun`, so neither fires on the named `gradedOne f` / `gradedAlgebraMap₀ f r` forms this file produces.
findings.fix: Add, next to `associatedGraded_of_mul_of`, `@[simp] theorem associatedGraded_of_gradedOne : DirectSum.of (GradedPiece f) 0 (gradedOne f) = 1` (via `gradedGOne_one` and `DirectSum.of_zero_one`) and `@[simp] theorem associatedGraded_of_gradedAlgebraMap₀ (r : R) : DirectSum.of (GradedPiece f) 0 (gradedAlgebraMap₀ f r) = algebraMap R (AssociatedGraded f) r` (via `DirectSum.algebraMap_apply`), plus the `GAlgebra.toFun = gradedAlgebraMap₀ f` restatement matching the existing `gradedGOne_one`/`gradedGMul_mul`.
findings.issue: `associatedGraded_of_mul_of` is the only lemma stated at the `AssociatedGraded f` level; the ring unit and the algebra map have no counterpart, so `DirectSum.of (GradedPiece f) 0 (gradedOne f)` and `DirectSum.of (GradedPiece f) 0 (gradedAlgebraMap₀ f r)` can only be identified with `1` and `algebraMap R (AssociatedGraded f) r` by unfolding the `GOne`/`GAlgebra.toFun` instance fields.

summary: All three prior findings are fixed: the PBW side now has `pbwFiltration_def`/`pbwFiltrationPrevious_def`, and the leftover Clifford `mul_mem_filtrationPrevious_*` and `instIsRingFiltration` are deleted. What remains is that the associated-graded ring/algebra is characterized only by its multiplication: no lemma identifies its unit or its scalars in terms of `gradedOne`/`gradedAlgebraMap₀`.
